purpose: Literature values and citation details shown on the V19 seminar deck. Authority: the literature corpus at JMP_lit_collection/Markdowns. The number source re-verifies every item at build time: its quote must occur (whitespace- and ligature-normalised) in the paper's canonical Markdown, on the recorded PDF page when one is given, and every numeral in the displayed string must occur in the quote (or, for a formatted value, in the recorded raw value). Benchmark values were also read against the original PDF pages.
